parsed.internal_thinking: Ziv is offering 1 Sheep for 1 Brick. I currently have 1 Brick and 2 Wheat. My goal is to settle at Node 50, which requires 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. I produce Brick on two 10 hexes, but I have no Sheep production at all. By accepting this trade, I obtain a resource I cannot produce myself (Sheep) in exchange for one I have a high probability of generating (Brick). Although I will still need to roll a 10 to get another Brick and an 11 for Wood, having the Sheep secured is a step forward. Ziv just upgraded to a city and likely needs the Brick for roads or settlements, but the trade-off is worth it for me to diversify my resources.
parsed.note_to_self: I traded my only Brick for a Sheep. I now have 2 Wheat and 1 Sheep. I need 1 Wood and 1 Brick to settle Node 50. I produce Brick on 10 and Wood on 11.
parsed.say_outloud: סבבה זיו, זה נשמע כמו עסקה טובה לשנינו. אני צריך את הכבשה הזאת.
